description: Partially update one item (HTTP PATCH — only the fields you supply change; omitted fields are preserved). Provide `item_key` and a `patch` object of the fields to change (e.g. {"title":"New","extra":"note"} or {"tags":[{"tag":"reviewed"}]}). All field values are plain JSON strings/numbers/booleans/arrays — never wrapped in nested objects (e.g. `"title": "New"`, NOT `"title": {"title": "New"}`). Optimistic concurrency is handled for you: if you pass the item's `version` it is used; otherwise the current version is fetched first. If the item changed on the server in the meantime (412), the update is automatically re-fetched and retried once. Writes go to the cloud Web API. Set `dry_run:true` to preview the field-level before→after diff without writing (arrays like tags/collections are replaced wholesale by PATCH, not merged; a dry_run call performs no write).

dry_run.description: Preview the field-level before→after diff without writing.

library_id.description: Numeric id of the library to address, e.g. 5234875 for a group (zotero_groups lists the ids you can reach). Omit to use the configured default library; an id given without library_type is read as a group id.

library_type.description: Which library to address: "user" (a personal library) or "group" (a shared group library). Omit to use the library this server is configured for. "group" on its own is refused: pass library_id with it.

patch.description: Object of fields to change (PATCH semantics), e.g. {"title": "New title", "date": "2024-02-01", "tags": [{"tag": "reviewed"}], "collections": ["ABCD1234"]}. Structured fields (creators, tags, collections, relations) must be real JSON arrays/objects, not JSON-encoded strings. Values are plain, never wrapped in nested objects.

creators.description: Array of creator objects: {creatorType, firstName, lastName} or {creatorType, name}.

itemType.description: The Zotero item type as a plain string, e.g. "journalArticle", "book", "preprint", "report", "thesis".

relations.description: Object mapping a relation predicate to a URI or array of URIs.

version.description: Known current version; fetched automatically if omitted.

name: zotero_update_item

arrayReplacements.description: Fields in that diff that PATCH replaces wholesale rather than merging, e.g. ["tags"].

diff.description: Field-level before/after for a dry run; only fields the patch would actually change.

newVersion.description: Version after the PATCH; absent on a dry run.

retried.description: True when a version conflict (412) was re-fetched and retried once.

version.description: Current version on the server (dry run only).

title: Update a Zotero item
